Eight_Eyed_Tubular_Turret_Cranium.description: This ghastly cranial appendage, a twisted fusion of arachnid and skeletal anatomy, sprouts a row of eight glassy eyes and a spindly turret-like structure that grants its bearer unparalleled vigilance and deadly precision in combat.

Sloping_Cheliceral_Anchor_Plates.description: Thick, chitin plates slope down from the formidable fangs of a colossal tarantula, reinforcing its powerful jaws and adding an intimidating bulk, though the cumbersome nature of these plates slightly hampers agility and mental acuity.

Eyeless_Blind_Cave_Carapace.description: This creature's chitinous exoskeleton, honed in the darkest depths of subterranean caves, bristles with sharp spines and bears no eyes, instead relying on a heightened sense of Blindsight to navigate its pitch-black domain with eerie precision and deadly speed.

Aggressively_Flattened_Ambush_Dome.description: This flattened arachnid exoskeleton, barely thicker than the ground it skitters across, is a master of stealth and ambush, its chitinous surface blending seamlessly with the earth as it readies its surprise attacks.

Elongated_Rostral_Prow.description: This razor-sharp, elongated exoskeletal prow juts menacingly from the creature's forehead, its pointed tip capable of piercing through the toughest armor, granting the arachnid a swift and deadly advantage in combat.

Hyper_Sclerotized_Scorpion_Shield.description: This component is a sclerotized exoskeleton, reminiscent of a colossal scorpion's carapace, providing unparalleled natural armor that fortifies the user against physical attacks, yet slightly diminishes their acute perception of their surroundings.

Trapdoor_Cork_Plug_Cranium.description: This bizarre, arachnid-derived exoskeletal plug is seamlessly integrated into the cranium, enhancing natural armor and cognitive resilience, though it restricts any form of traversal, sealing the entity within a fortified, immobile state.

Elevated_Ocular_Tubercle_Stalk.description: Emerging from the elongated exoskeleton of this harvestman, the Elevated Ocular Tubercle Stalk is a slender, sensory appendage that enhances its perception and agility, allowing it to detect and evade threats with uncanny precision.

Mandibular_Horned_Carapace.description: The Mandibular_Horned_Carapace is a chitinous exoskeleton adorned with sharp, menacing horns, giving its bearer an imposing presence that naturally intimidates foes and rivals alike, bolstering their physical prowess and charisma.

Translucent_Cephalic_Dome.description: The Translucent_Cephalic_Dome is a delicate yet resilient exoskeletal structure that envelops the cephalothorax of an arachnid, its near-transparent surface granting a slight cognitive edge and an uncanny ability to blend into shadows, enhancing the wearer’s stealth.
